# Daily Dashboard V0.4.1

## Release scope

- Replaced the reactive idle display with a location- and time-aware night sky, projected constellations, larger hover targets, and educational popups.
- Reworked the pixel fish pond with species-specific fish, independent steering, cursor pursuit and orbiting, autonomous wandering, separation, and edible pixel food.
- Replaced the idle topographic layer with label-free hillshade and an eased tour of nearby terrain landmarks, walking/hiking routes, and waterways, with an offline fallback route.
- Added crop-to-fill and contain-with-animated-blurred-background slideshow modes.
- Fixed the idle selector visibility interval and selected-label contrast.
- Fixed nested slideshow folder loading and immediate folder-setting persistence.
- Added authenticated GitHub release checks and installer downloads for the private repository, including an actionable message when repository access is missing.
- Retains all V0.4 scaling, compact-calendar, iCalendar recurrence, ADS-B, weather radar, feature-flag, map interaction, and update-assistant improvements.

## Updating from V0.4

V0.4.1 is deliberately versioned above V0.4 so the application update assistant will offer it. Because `BananaAficionado/DailyDashboard` is private, enter a fine-grained GitHub token with **Contents: read** access under **Settings → Application updates**. The release asset is an NSIS Windows installer and supports both immediate silent installation and installation at the next Windows sign-in.

## Verification

- `npm run build`
- `npm test`
- `npm run test:responsive`
- `cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml`
- Windows x64 production cross-compilation
- Interactive Codex preview of fish pursuit/orbiting, food consumption, constellation targets, and terrain movement
